shortDescription: TORONTO, Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV: NEXG; OTCQX: NXGCF) (“NexGold” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that its fully permitted Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia has been selected for inclusion in the Canada Investment Summit Prospectus, which will be giv…

children: ”) is pleased to announce that its fully permitted Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia has been selected for inclusion in the Canada Investment Summit Prospectus, which will be given to leading global investors at the inaugural Canada Investment Summit, hosted by Prime Minister Mark Carney in partnership with CPP Investments and PSP Investments, in Toronto on September 14-15, 2026.

Kevin Bullock, President, CEO & Director of NexGold, commented: “I am honoured on behalf of NexGold to see the Goldboro Gold Project showcased in the Canada Investment Summit Prospectus, which will be presented to some of the world’s largest long-horizon institutional investors and prominent business leaders. Goldboro’s inclusion in the Summit Prospectus speaks not only to the quality of the Project from an investment standpoint but is also a testament to the hard work of our team in advancing the Project, while building strong relationships with local communities and First Nations. As a Canadian company advancing a portfolio of Canadian projects toward production, we are proud to have the Goldboro Gold Project featured among the projects highlighted at this high-profile global event.”

NexGold is steadily advancing its fully permitted Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia. The Company is evaluating a potential construction decision for Goldboro, which is currently anticipated in 2026. The Goldboro Gold Project is located in Guysborough County, Nova Scotia, approximately 1.6 km north of the Village of Goldboro. Situated along Route 316, the Project benefits from access to world class infrastructure, services and a skilled workforce, supporting efficient future development activities. Based on the Project’s 2022 Mineral Resource Estimate, Goldboro contains an estimated 2.58 million ounces of gold within 21.6 million tonnes grading 3.72 g/t gold. According to the Goldboro Feasibility Study, the Project is expected to have a mine life of approximately 11 years and average annual gold production of approximately 100,000 ounces during the initial years of operation, with potential opportunities for future expansion.

The inaugural Canada Investment Summit will take place in Toronto on September 14-15, 2026. Hosted by the Prime Minister of Canada in partnership with CPP Investments and PSP Investments, the Summit will convene the world’s largest investors, including top CEOs, entrepreneurs, and prominent global business leaders for a two-day forum focused on long-horizon capital, commercial opportunities and productive assets that strengthen Canada’s growth and economic resilience. The Summit forms part of the Government of Canada’s broader effort to strengthen Canada’s investment environment, diversify trade and attract approximately $1 trillion in total investment in Canada over the next five years.

NexGold is a gold-focused company with assets in Canada and Alaska, including the Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia, the Goliath Gold Complex (which includes the Goliath, Goldlund and Miller deposits) in Northwestern Ontario, and additional exploration projects across Canada. NexGold also holds a 100% interest in the high-grade Niblack copper-gold-zinc-silver VMS project in southeast Alaska. NexGold is committed to ongoing, meaningful engagement with regional communities and Indigenous Nations to support sustainable development, safe operations, and shared economic and social benefits.
